scope: Exploratory follow-up introduced after the ImageNet-only reference achieved 192/192 and some primary outcomes were visible; same reused development test scenes
question: Do personal-video auxiliary losses help when simulator adaptation labels are scarce?
train_scene_seeds: 10000 through 10031, selected by index without reading outcomes
initialization: reuse frozen completed primary phone-video encoders; R uses the same original ImageNet encoder
control_and_scoring: identical frozen primary physics and state machine
selection: all 15 final checkpoints and all 64 test scenes; no checkpoint/group/seed selection
interpretation: label-budget comparison at equal optimizer steps, not equal dataset epochs; no new real or synthetic test distribution
